title: English Practice Quiz 0778
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 01: Good workplace ergonomics aims to?
options: reduce strain through suitable work setup
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: reduce strain through suitable work setup.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 02: Taking short movement breaks can?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: reduce prolonged static posture.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 03: A workplace wellbeing programme may support?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: physical and mental wellbeing.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 04: An employee feeling unwell at work should?
options: inform the appropriate supervisor and follow policy
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: inform the appropriate supervisor and follow policy.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 05: Adequate hydration helps?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: maintain normal body functions.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 06: A safe lifting technique includes?
options: bending the knees and keeping the load close
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: bending the knees and keeping the load close.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 07: Work-related stress may be reduced by?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: reasonable workload planning and support.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 08: A workstation screen should be positioned to?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: support a comfortable neutral posture.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 09: Reporting a workplace injury promptly helps?
options: ensure appropriate care and incident recording
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: ensure appropriate care and incident recording.

questions.question: Health and Wellbeing at Work 10: A healthy sleep routine supports?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: alertness and concentration.
